title: trailboss --json folders place
description: Where each space given on stdin ([{id, cwd, machine}]) goes. A hand-filing wins; otherwise the most specific rule; otherwise the top level.

folder.description: The folder id, or null for the top level.

by.description: `hand`, `rule`, or null when nothing placed it.

rule.description: The rule that matched, when `by` is `rule`.
